title: ChatGPT vs Claude ....Help me decide
author: Doomer_Shooter
selftext:
I'm using the £200 ghatgpt plan with Unreal MCP and it's insane. Spits out features almost perfectly 95% of the time ....Can be slow but i have nothing to compare it to. Only thing it lacks in is animation and VFX. Honestly i am very happy with how powerful Codex is so don't have a reason to switch

That said ...everything i see on here seems to be around claude models. Are they that much better? Are they worth a try?

comments.author: StoneCypher
comments.body: the key step is hooking your agent up to blender.

replies.author: Doomer_Shooter
replies.body: I don’t want ai to make assets, I made my own art

replies.author: StoneCypher
replies.body:
oh, i apologize for misunderstanding 

blender is great for vfx though

replies.author: Doomer_Shooter
replies.body: Saying that I do use blender MCP + codex for fixing meshes, adding details and fixing rigs (godsend for that). Would you say Claude is better in blender. Cos codex sucks for anything more than tweaking

replies.author: StoneCypher
replies.body:
i have not actually used blender with chatgpt so that isn't a comparison i'm able to make

i do know that claude seemed really bad at blender for several hours until i figured out how to teach it what i was looking for 

one belief i'm coming to (can't justify this, almost a faith) is that a huge part of successfully working with these tools is giving them better ways to evaluate their own output

replies.author: Doomer_Shooter
replies.body: I forgot about discord ….and servers you can recommend?

replies.author: Ixll
replies.body: Do you just connect blender thru the AI’s connections? Or is it more involved? I’m looking to make 2.5d animations for a game similar to Ragnarok online

replies.author: StoneCypher
replies.body:
yeah, set up something called the "blender mcp."  that gives your ai a bunch of tools - not just editing scene objects, but also stuff like taking screenshots so it can look at its work, and so forth

you can ask claude how and it'll talk you through the process.  pretty easy, five minutes of work

comments.author: ChillmanITB
comments.body: honestly rn claude is the one. it gets you much further (this used to be the other way round). Also it just gets it 'right' more often than gpt. I was literally just thinking this as I saw this post so I had to comment lol.

replies.author: Doomer_Shooter
replies.body: Thanks. I do think I’m gonna have to give it a go. Does it hold on to broad project context well?

replies.author: ChillmanITB
replies.body: I would say so yes. But I’m unsure of the size of your projects!

comments.author: BigPlans2022
comments.body: i prefer chatgpt because it has image gen.

comments.author: J3RM0
comments.body: Gpt is trash for game development compared to Claude in my opinion. I just use Astra to go over design plans and double check code.

replies.author: Doomer_Shooter
replies.body:
Well it’s not ‘trash’. I’m using it to do very specific tasks such as “take this enemy and add an extra layer of hit-react over the existing animation system so it flinches during cooldowns” ….a task it aced first time.

So my question is really, how is Claude better specifically? Because if it’s far superior to this then maybe I’m missing something

comments.author: je386
comments.body:
Claude.

I can use several models inside of github copilot coding agent, and the claude/Anthropic models are better than the GPT/openAI models

replies.author: Doomer_Shooter
replies.body: Better how? What task can I do with Claude that ChatGPT would struggle with?

replies.author: je386
replies.body: It seems to have a better understanding, so its faster and cheaper. I am only talking about coding tasks here.

comments.author: teejayaiartdirector
comments.body: ChatGPT (more or less unlimited usage) vs (super expensive and restricted) Claude! 🤔

replies.author: teejayaiartdirector
replies.body: The price for Claude usage is insane! I've been spamming my GPT 6 Astra 100$ sub at max usage with projects since release and I've still been unable to use up my weekly usage even once! And OpenAI is spamming free resets all the time.

replies.author: Doomer_Shooter
replies.body: I did notice the free resets to be honest

replies.author: teejayaiartdirector
replies.body: I must admit I don't have 1st hand experience with Claude myself. But I've seen lots of people complain about Claude usage on various AI discord servers I'm on.
